items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Steve Lewis? Huh? Steve Lewis? No.

ctx.x: Huh? Fats P. Sean? No, not Fats. Steve Lewis? Huh? Steve Lewis? No.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I say it's Steve Lewis, huh? He's dead. Yeah, he's dead.

ctx.x: Ask him who were some of the good piano players he heard.
So who were some of the good piano players you know then? Let me see. Steve Lewis? You got the right one all right. Odell, I think. Odell. Odell. Odell. Odell. Odell Wilson.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And he used to get all those youngsters like me... would play.

ctx.x: What about Bud Russell? Bud Russell?

Oh, Bud Russel. Russel. Yeah, he, you see, I got to spell it wrong, isn't it? Bud Russel. But he had a band a long time. You remember a boy, don't you, Bud Russel? Bass player. Oh, he had different bands, you know. And he used to get all those youngsters like me, George McCullum. Little young fellas, you know, would play. And we kept him up. He always get a good band. He kept up to, he couldn't play no more, you know. Went to work, things got data on there. He'd get plenty of work through it. How long has he been…

You know. What about Blonde Charlie? Don't interrupt him. Don't interrupt him. Don't interrupt him. Tell him. and different things like that. Every time we used a good chord, we were right time music then. We didn't know nothing about jazz, you know. Every time we used a good chord, right time music then. What about Blanc Charlie? Steve Lewis, he could play. What about Blanc Charlie?
